protocol.physics: protocol v1 (ledger.build): published spec, FS power limit, KinematiK defaults for the rest
protocol.1 calibration: time factor = median(official / predicted) on the training competition's clean runs; skidpad per compound group (R20, LC0, other; pooled below 4 cars), acceleration pooled
protocol.2 data checks: published values outside {'wheelbase_mm': (1525.0, 2000.0), 'track_f_mm': (900.0, 1600.0), 'track_r_mm': (900.0, 1600.0), 'weight_f_kg': (50.0, 250.0), 'weight_r_kg': (50.0, 250.0), 'power_per_motor_kw': (3.0, 150.0), 'max_rpm': (2000.0, 30000.0), 'ratio_primary': (1.0, 30.0)} are treated as not published; a redline and ratio capping the car below 25.0 m/s drop the motor map
protocol.3 published inputs: tyre compound (calibration group) and tyre diameter; aero not used (unreliable)
protocol.4 team record: prediction x (1 + 0.5 x (last competition's official / calibrated prediction - 1)), same team (FSG team id), clean runs only; events ('skidpad',)
protocol.5 skidpad: path radius 7.625 m + 0.25 m + half the mean track; the faster of left and right laps is scored as a second channel

note: Forward: fit on FSG 2025, predict FSG 2026. Results for both years were public when this was made.
